_schema.purpose: Described image library. At build time Claude reads this file and retrieves images BY MEANING (match slide intent against description + suggested_use + tags), then honors entitlement. See SPEC.md section 4 and .scratch/deck-tool/research/02-image-library-semantics-findings.md.

fields.entitlement: public | named-customer | mutares-family  (an image may appear only in a deck cleared for its entitlement; public is always allowed)
fields.description: one sentence of meaning; also reused as the
fields.suggested_use: message-level phrases in Oppr's own vocabulary (Capture -> Connect -> Execute, 'operators are the sensor')
